field_principles.arc_live_delta: The measured zero delta remains a scientific null with no registry credit.
field_principles.arc_live_delta_measured: Exp5753 ran a development-proxy live A/B and measured its delta.
field_principles.archived_task_ids: Lists exactly the Exp5743-Exp5754 denominator carried from the terminal milestone.
field_principles.artifact_hashes: Binds every present canonical artifact to exact bytes and every absent artifact to an explicit missing state.
field_principles.blocked_task_ids: Gate-blocked or missing tasks stay blocked and cannot be counted as scientific measurements.
field_principles.collision_scan: Next-range allocation is valid only when pre-existing implementation/result collisions are absent.
field_principles.conductor_outcomes: Preserves latest conductor OK, GATE_BLOCK, and preemptive-skip evidence separately from science artifacts.
field_principles.conductor_unchanged: Bare boolean must remain true by operator instruction.
field_principles.docs_reconciled: Records whether research-complete already contains exactly one terminal .513 block without rewriting history.
field_principles.experiment: Stable local experiment slug for result indexing.
field_principles.experiment_id: Binds this receipt to the conductor task id.
field_principles.field_principles: Maps every artifact field to the evidence boundary that justifies it.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal summary starts with complete: or blocked: and does not inflate blocked work into science.
field_principles.inference_substrate: This transition reads cached artifacts and ledgers only; no LLM, solver, benchmark, or hardware run is performed.
field_principles.kan_mechanism_residual: The signed Exp5749 residual controls KAN-specific claims only.
field_principles.milestone_from: Names the terminal milestone whose evidence is archived.
field_principles.milestone_to: Names the newly active milestone receiving the archived evidence.
field_principles.negative_result_task_ids: Negative measured results remain distinct from blocked tasks.
field_principles.next_task_range: Records the Exp5755-Exp5768 range allocated for the destination milestone.
field_principles.positive_result_task_ids: Positive readiness results remain bounded to their direct evidence.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records artifact, ledger, roadmap, vNEXT, collision, and protected-file checks before transition claims are trusted.
field_principles.proposal_benchmark_ready: Only the sealed Exp5746 benchmark receipts make the benchmark ready.
field_principles.proposal_utility_measured: Blocked Exp5747 and skipped Exp5748 mean proposal utility was not measured.
field_principles.random_seed: Deterministic metadata even though no stochastic science runs.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Stable content checksum detects artifact drift.
field_principles.research_roadmap_unchanged: Bare boolean must remain true because this workflow is record-only.
field_principles.run_date: Absolute operator date used for this transition.
field_principles.rust_10x_measured: A gate-shaped Exp5752 block means no final 10x measurement happened.
field_principles.rust_restart_parity_ready: Exp5751 parity repair is semantic readiness, not throughput.
field_principles.schema: Identifies the versioned Exp5755 artifact schema.
field_principles.scientific_null_task_ids: Scientific zero/null outcomes are reported only for tasks that actually ran.
field_principles.spec_refs: OpenSpec anchors for this artifact's behavior.
field_principles.status: Bare terminal state derived from explicit transition preconditions.
field_principles.test_exit_codes: Observed exit codes are recorded without relabeling failures.
